author: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), from Codex model-test pack

origin.note: head-aligned connector mouth; heroes and supports are born here in full motion

callout.reducedMotion: no travel or spin: fade in place, swap poses while invisible, punctuation static, no momentum ticks; same quiet tail as full

garden-bbq.label: Garden BBQ
storyBeats: the grill rises out of his head
charcoal tips in and the heat starts
sausages, then hot dogs, flip onto the bars

make-sandwich.label: Sandwich assembly
storyBeats: the bread rises out of his head
the stack presses into a finished sandwich

washing-up.label: Washing up
storyBeats: the dirty plate rises out of his head
water drops in, the sponge scrubs
clean cutlery glints beside the plate

general-repair.label: General repair
storyBeats: the toolbox rises out of his head
the hull patch is set against the job
the hammer strikes three times, the wrench spins tight
the tools pack away and a tied rope knot resolves
